hdfc_millennia.raw_answer:
# HDFC Millennia Credit Card Research Report

Here is the fee, cashback, and eligibility analysis for the HDFC Millennia Credit Card based on official HDFC Bank sources.

### Fees and Charges
* **Joining/Annual Fee:** ₹1,000 plus applicable taxes ([Source](https://www.hdfc.bank.in/credit-cards/millennia-credit-card)).
* **Renewal Fee:** ₹1,000 plus applicable taxes ([Source](https://v.hdfc.bank.in/content/dam/hdfc-aem-microsites/millennia-microsite1/pdfs/CreditCard.pdf)).
* **Fee Waiver Conditions:** The renewal fee is waived if you spend ₹1,00,000 or more in a year/12 months prior to the renewal date ([Source](https://www.hdfc.bank.in/credit-cards/millennia-credit-card-fees-and-charges), [Source](https://v.hdfc.bank.in/content/dam/hdfc-aem-microsites/millennia-microsite1/pdfs/CreditCard.pdf)).

### Cashback Rates
* **Cashback Features:** Offers up to 5% cashback on specific online platforms (such as Amazon) and welcome vouchers worth ₹1,000 ([Source](https://vocal.media/journal/hdfc-millennia-credit-card-features-benefits-and-charges-2025)).

### Eligibility Criteria
* ⚠️ **Specific Criteria:** Specific income, age, or employment criteria are not explicitly detailed in the provided official text snippets. Applicants are required to check their eligibility through the online eligibility calculator on the official HDFC website ([Source](https://www.hdfc.bank.in/credit-cards)).

***

*Disclaimer: Please verify all fees, charges, and terms directly with HDFC Bank before applying, as policies are subject to change.*

icici_amazon_pay.query: What are the exact reward rates for Amazon Pay ICICI Credit Card in 2024?
icici_amazon_pay.raw_answer:
Here is the breakdown of the reward rates for the Amazon Pay ICICI Credit Card based on official ICICI Bank sources:

### **Amazon Pay ICICI Credit Card Reward Structure**

* **Amazon.in Shopping Spends:**
  * **Amazon Prime Members:** Earn **5% unlimited cashback** (in the form of Amazon Pay balance) on purchases made on Amazon India [Source: [ICICI Bank](https://www.icicibank.com/about-us/news-room/2025/amazon-pay-and-icici-bank-renew-partnership-enhance-indias-most-adopted-co-branded-credit-card), [ICICI Bank Blogs](https://www.icicibank.com/blogs/credit-card/shopping-credit-card)].
  * **Non-Prime Members:** Earn **3% cashback** on purchases made on Amazon India [Source: [ICICI Bank](https://www.icicibank.com/about-us/news-room/2018/news-icici-bank-launch-cobranded-credit-card-with-amazon), [ICICI Bank FAQs](https://www.icicibank.com/Personal-Banking/faq/card/amazon-pay-faq.page?)].

* **Digital Categories on Amazon.in:**
  * **All Customers:** Earn **2% back** on digital category spends on Amazon.in (such as utility bill payments, recharges, etc.) [Source: [ICICI Bank](https://www.icicibank.com/about-us/news-room/2020/news-amazon-pay-icici-bank-credit-card-is-fastest-to-cross-1-million-milestone)].

* **Travel Bookings:**
  * Earn **5% unlimited rewards** on eligible travel bookings [Source: [ICICI Bank](https://www.icicibank.com/about-us/news-room/2025/amazon-pay-and-icici-bank-renew-partnership-enhance-indias-most-adopted-co-branded-credit-card)]. 

*Disclaimer: Reward rates, terms, and conditions are subject to change. Please verify the latest details directly with ICICI Bank before applying.*

research__what_is_the_minimum_income_req.card_name: What is the minimum income required for HDFC Regalia Credit
research__what_is_the_minimum_income_req.query: What is the minimum income required for HDFC Regalia Credit Card?
research__what_is_the_minimum_income_req.raw_answer:
### HDFC Regalia / Regalia Gold Credit Card Income Eligibility

As an expert credit card analyst, here is the breakdown of the minimum income required for the HDFC Regalia credit card variants based on official guidelines:

#### **HDFC Regalia / Regalia Gold (Retail)**
* **Salaried Individuals:** Net monthly income greater than **₹1,00,000** per month ([HDFC Regalia Eligibility](https://www.hdfcbank.com/personal/pay/cards/credit-cards/regalia/eligibility)). 
  * *Note:* For government employees, the income criteria specifies at least ₹1 lakh ([HDFC Regalia Gold Eligibility](https://www.hdfcbank.com/personal/pay/cards/credit-cards/regalia-gold-credit-card/eligibility)). ⚠️
* **Self-Employed Individuals:** Requires a strong Income Tax Return (ITR). While specific self-employed monthly thresholds for standard Regalia are generalized around ₹1,00,000 p.m. / high ITRs ([Paisabazaar HDFC Eligibility](https://www.paisabazaar.com/hdfc-bank/credit-card-eligibility/)), business variants specify an ITR of **> ₹12 lakh annually** ([Business Regalia Eligibility](https://www.hdfcbank.com/personal/pay/cards/business-credit-cards/business-regalia/eligibility)). ⚠️

#### **Additional General Criteria**
* **Age Requirements:** 
  * Salaried: 21 to 60 years ([HDFC Regalia Eligibility](https://www.hdfcbank.com/personal/pay/cards/credit-cards/regalia/eligibility)).
  * Self-Employed: 21 to 65 years ([HDFC Regalia Eligibility](https://www.hdfcbank.com/personal/pay/cards/credit-cards/regalia/eligibility)).

***

*Disclaimer: Please verify the final eligibility criteria and income requirements directly with HDFC Bank before applying, as policies are subject to change.*
